notes: NOT_IN_PACKET: per-arm event counts and explicit numeric per-arm denominators. Only ovulation percentages are reported. The study states 32 women were equally allocated, but per-arm totals cannot be calculated under the extraction rules. Both arms received clomifene citrate; metformin was 850 mg two times a day. Ovulation detection was assessed on the 7th, 11th and 13th day of the cycle. The abstract does not clarify whether percentages describe participants or cycles across the maximum three trials.
